title: Sage in the Cage
lines: A pet rat, Sage, is in the cage.
Ben sets the cage up on the stage.
"This is Sage," Ben tells his class.
Ben is sad, but not in a rage.
A bit of ham lands on the page.
Sage runs back, and Ben shuts the cage.

questions.listenFor: A pet rat. If they say "a pet," ask what kind, and let them find it on the page.

questions.ask: How does Ben get Sage back?
questions.listenFor: The bit of ham on the page. Listen for the ham as the reason Sage came back.

questions.ask: Do you think Ben did the right thing when Sage got out? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Look for a reason from the story, like "yes, he stayed calm instead of getting mad."
